prompt: Friendly, accurate educational infographic for a beginner biology lesson showing a bird's digestive system. A simple side-view bird illustration, facing left, drawn in a clean flat style with a beak and no teeth. A clear curved arrowed food pathway runs from the beak through the body, with arrows showing the direction food travels. Organs are shown in soft, distinct colors inside the bird silhouette: beak/mouth, esophagus, crop, proventriculus, gizzard, small intestine, large intestine, and cloaca. Each organ has a clean, readable label with a short role caption beneath it. Warm natural color palette of terracotta, sage green, cream, golden ochre, and soft brown on an off-white parchment background. Uncluttered layout, generous spacing, simple icon-like shapes, crisp sans-serif typography, title across the top.
negativePrompt: teeth, human, photorealistic, dark background, cluttered, busy, overlapping labels, misspelled text, extra unlabeled organs, gibberish text, watermark, blurry, distorted anatomy
